# utilities (2026-10-15): PDF reader, web browser, image viewer, "open with"
# (imv's command is imv-wayland: plain imv belongs to renameutils)
# Qt 6 programs under sway (Recommends of libqt6gui6, found 2026-10-21 with
# tools/recommends_check.py): without qt6-wayland no Qt 6 program starts
# ("no Qt platform plugin could be initialized"); qt6-svg-plugins for SVG
# icons. (qt6-qpa-plugins, also recommended, only holds VNC and TUIO
# touch plugins: not needed.)
qt6-wayland
qt6-svg-plugins
# SVG loader for GTK programs (icons; Recommends of GTK 3/4 and the icon theme)
librsvg2-common

imv

xdg-utils
